newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch-Indian aid package worth 500 mln guilders.
newsitem.headline: Dutch-Indian aid package worth 500 mln guilders.

text.p: The Dutch package to stimulate exports to India and inward investment there will have an indicated total size of about 500 million guilders, the Dutch ministry for Economic Affairs said on Tuesday.
"But this sum will enable a substantially larger amount in transactions to take place," it said in a statement.

On Monday, Dutch junior minister for foreign trade Anneke van Dok said in New Delhi, where she was leading a Dutch business delegation, the Netherlands would offer a financial package and increase technical assistance to India.
Details of the package, which follow similar Dutch deals with China and Indonesia, will be decided in negotiations with the Indian government, the ministry said.
It said Van Dok had proposed the package to have a maturity of seven years, during which the Dutch want to meet the Indian authorities twice per year to discuss its progress.
The package includes subsidies for feasibility studies and technical assistance, loans for investments and guarantees for venture capital companies investing in India.
"Since 1991, total direct approved investment from the Netherlands in India amounted to 950 million guilders," van Dok said on Tuesday in India.
